ground_truth_diagnosis: checkout-api pods are in CrashLoopBackOff because they cannot connect to redis. The root cause is that redis-master-0 (in the redis namespace) was OOMKilled — its 256Mi memory limit is too tight for the working set after a recent traffic spike. The redis replicas are healthy, but checkout-api is hard-coded to talk to redis-master, so it fails to start. Fix: raise the redis-master memory limit (or move checkout-api to read from replicas).
